nlp_samples.text: 65-year-old female on COUMADIN for atrial fibrillation. Presented with melena and hemoglobin drop; endoscopy showed gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Warfarin held. Onset ~10 days after dose increase.
nlp_samples.note: Fictional narrative for demo; brand maps to WARFARIN in the pipeline.

nlp_samples.text: Patient taking LIPITOR 40mg developed severe muscle pain and weakness; CK markedly elevated consistent with rhabdomyolysis. Simvastatin interaction suspected.
nlp_samples.note: Illustrates brand names and serious ADR keywords.

nlp_samples.text: After amoxicillin for otitis, patient developed lip swelling and difficulty breathing within 2 hours — treated as anaphylactic reaction. No prior penicillin allergy documented.
nlp_samples.note: Onset phrase and reaction terms for rule-based extraction.
